parsed.rationale: All four types — `AccentHueKey`, `AccentSaturationKey`, `AccentBrightnessKey`, and `LCDActiveBrightnessKey` — are `type-alias-object` records in the same file (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`) within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, each with an identical structural shape (`shared_field_count: 1`, `fields_or_signature: []`). This is the canonical SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` boilerplate pattern: a struct with a single `defaultValue` property, repeated verbatim for every new key. A Swift attached macro `@EnvironmentKey` could synthesize the conformance and `defaultValue` from a single declaration, reducing four near-identical structs to four one-line macro applications. No restraint markers are present on any record.
